blocks.text: Deuteronomy 12 contains 32 verses. It opens with: These are the statutes and the ordinances which ye shall observe to do in the land which Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath given thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth. It concludes with: What thing soever I command you, that shall ye observe to do: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The repeated instruction is rhetorically adapted covenant exposition for a successor generation, not a simple verbatim duplication of earlier laws.
